resources.string: Catalogue direction with proper motion and parallax. Vega and Altair rotate rapidly: shape and surface temperature depend on latitude. The symbol is illustrative.
Deneb is a blue-white supergiant. The adopted distance is about 802 parsecs; its physical properties are uncertain reference estimates.
Four principal stars of Crux, at different distances. Extend the Gacrux–Acrux axis beyond Acrux to estimate the south celestial pole. The track follows the pattern’s centre, not the pole.
